subject: Invoice sender & notification preference for Fleetwave (email vs portal)
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@fleetwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@fleetwave.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who will send invoices and how will we receive notices?

Hi Karthik,

We're getting the billing fields set up on our side for the Redwood contract (DL-3489). A quick question on logistics: who should be the originating sender for invoices on your side? Our AP team wants to know whether invoices will come from a Redwood "billing" sender (billing@redwood.com) via email, or if you expect us to pull them from a vendor portal.

Also: when you publish credits/adjustments or zero-dollar corrections, do you email a copy to accounts-payable or only post to the portal?

We prefer consolidated monthly invoices delivered to accounts-payable@fleetwave.com, but can accept portal-only if that's your standard. Importantly, we need a PDF copy emailed for our PO system when there are credit memos.

Can you confirm the default flow and whether you can make exceptions per-customer?

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Senior Accounts Payable Analyst
Fleetwave Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@fleetwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Who will send invoices and how will we receive notices?

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear question. Short answer: we support both.

Longer: our standard is to originate invoices from billing@redwood.com and deliver a PDF copy to the AP email on file (accounts-payable@fleetwave.com) every month. For customers that want portal-first, we can instead publish consolidated monthly invoices to our billing portal and optionally send an email copy when a credit memo or adjustment occurs.

If you need PDF copies of credit memos emailed automatically, we can enable that for your account (it's a per-customer toggle). When enabled we'll also include a short XML invoice feed for automated ingestion if Fleetwave wants that (there's a small setup task).

I've attached a sample invoice PDF so you can confirm formatting; SOW attached for reference.

Proposed default: billing@redwood.com sends monthly PDFs to accounts-payable@fleetwave.com. Portal enabled as the canonical source.

Next steps: if that works, Marissa will record the preference on the deal and Laura will create the portal account and turn on emailed credit memos. If you prefer portal-only, say so and we'll flip the toggle.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_DL-3489.pdf

Thanks Anna — copying operational details below so your AP team knows what to expect.

Operational plan (recommended):
- Monthly consolidated invoice published to Redwood billing portal on the 5th of the month (PDF + ledger).
- A PDF copy emailed to accounts-payable@fleetwave.com at the same time.
- Credit memos/adjustments: we will email a PDF to AP and post the record in the portal. We can tag those emails with the PO number if you provide it.
- If Fleetwave wants to consume machine-readable data, we can enable the XML feed (SFTP or webhook).

Action items for Fleetwave:
1) Confirm preferred channel: portal+email (recommended) or portal-only.
2) Provide your PO number format (e.g., PO-12345) so we include it on emails.
3) Confirm VAT/EU tax handling if invoicing will be split across entities.

I'll queue the portal user setup for Fleetwave once we have the confirmation. Karthik — please ensure the credit memo toggle is enabled for this account.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
